in_marathi.name: Dharitree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharitree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharitree is a name of Goddess Earth in Hindu mythology. She is the one who sustains all living beings with nourishment and shelter. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Dhari’ (to hold) and ‘Tree’ (tree), representing the provider of sustenance.
